  - Laplace Transform Examples
    - [Part 1: Simple examples](https://nps01-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/g/personal/bbingham_nps_edu/IQAF6KsdUx1mR6CXCXZtN3x2AQ9lYMGJ3tOzE3aBi2HOiLM?e=jHRG8j) (7:22)
    - [Part 2: Using the frequency-shift property](https://nps01-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/g/personal/bbingham_nps_edu/EVj6oGSB1yFHutdmMqR5xDQBL3eKyy9zunKtJN3DXWhU1A?e=d0xbda) (6:03) — static notes: [example_freq_shift.pdf](weeks/w01_laplace_part1/files/example_freq_shift.pdf)
  - [Inverse Laplace and Partial Fraction Expansion (Real Poles)](https://nps01-my.sharepoint.com/:v:/g/personal/bbingham_nps_edu/IQBuK6aU4GYXT65qSm42n7YUAd37ZFznoQ9lmOzgjvBA6VM?e=3M4h1i) (15:29)
  - Slides: [lec_w1_laplaceintro_annotated.pdf](weeks/w01_laplace_part1/files/lec_w1_laplaceintro_annotated.pdf)
- Handouts: Laplace properties and pairs (two equivalent versions)
  - Nise textbook tables: [nise-handout.pdf](handouts/nise-handout.pdf)

  - [A few things to note about the mathematical definition of the Laplace transform](https://lpsa.swarthmore.edu/LaplaceXform/FwdLaplace/LaplaceFuncs.html), from Swarthmore

  - Laplace transform, units and initial conditions: [laplace_ic_units.pdf](weeks/w01_laplace_part1/files/laplace_ic_units.pdf)
  - Step and delta functions, from [MIT IAP course 18.031](https://math.mit.edu/~stoopn/18.031/)
